commands.review_summary:
This PR caps the Microsoft Teams `resolveTeamGroupId` process-local team-group-id cache at 500 entries with `pruneMapToMaxSize` and adds a root-level proof script.

PR surface: Source +3, Other +36. Total +39 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: repeated successful `resolveTeamGroupId` calls with distinct Teams IDs within the TTL add entries to `teamGroupIdCache` on current main without a fixed cap. I did not establish this with a live Teams run.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Contributor follow-up is needed because the branch must remove or convert the proof artifact and add real behavior proof; ClawSweeper should not repair a contributor-owned proof gate.

target.title: fix(msteams): cap team-group-id cache with pruneMapToMaxSize
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `teamGroupIdCache` Map in `resolveTeamGroupId` had TTL-based expiry (10 min) but no size cap. A large Teams workspace with many distinct team IDs could accumulate entries faster than the TTL window, allowing unbounded growth.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a 500-entry cap via `pruneMapToMaxSize` — the shared SDK helper already used by 11 other files. The cap is applied after each successful cache insert.

## User Impact

No change for normal usage. Memory usage bounded at ~500 entries regardless of workspace size.

## Evidence

### `_teamGroupIdCacheForTest` proof — cache stays at 500 after 501+ inserts

The proof imports the real `_teamGroupIdCacheForTest` (exposed for testing), fills it with 501 entries while calling `pruneMapToMaxSize` on each insert (matching the production `resolveTeamGroupId` code path), and shows the cache stays capped at 500:

```text
$ node --import tsx graph-thread-proof.mjs 2>&1

=== Proof: resolveTeamGroupId cache capped at 500 ===

--- Fill cache with 501 entries ---
Cache size after 501 insert+prune cycles: 500
Has team-0 (oldest):  false
Has team-500 (newest): true
OK: cache stays at 500, oldest entry evicted

--- Second cycle (insert team-501) ---
Cache size after 502nd insert: 500
OK: cache still capped

=== Proof complete ===
```

The same `pruneMapToMaxSize(teamGroupIdCache, 500)` is called in `resolveTeamGroupId` after each successful Graph API lookup.

### Lint

```text
$ npx oxlint extensions/msteams/src/graph-thread.ts
0 errors, 0 warnings
```
